

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Fire Pig|kanji=丁亥|romaji=hinoto i|onyomi=teigai|p=dīhài|w=ting-hai|mi=tʰiŋ⁵³ xaɪ̯|y=deng1 hoi6|j=deng1 hoi6|ci=tɛŋ hɐi|mc=tæŋ ɣəi|oc-bs=tæŋ ɢəʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Pig''' (丁亥, ''hinoto i''; onyomi ''teigai'') is the 24th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 24th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Dog|ja|丙戌}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Rat|ja|戊子}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''亥'' (Pig) is Yin Water; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Fire Pig (丁亥)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): dīnghài
** Cantonese (Jyutping): ding1 hoi6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoto-i
*** On'yomi: teigai
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): jeonghae (정해)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Đinh Hợi

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Jitō Tennō}}'s 1st year (687 AD), from the Asukaike Kōbō Ruins, {{ill|Fuhonsen|en|Fuhonsen|qid=Q11456988|lt=Tomihon-sen}} were detected and wooden tablets inscribed with "丁亥年" were unearthed from the same soil layer, leading to the estimation that the Tomihon-sen were cast during this period.
* In {{ill|Ōei|en|Ōei|qid=Q1193078|lt=Ōei}} 14 (January 1408 AD), the {{ill|1408 Ōei earthquake|ja|応永地震|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōei Earthquake|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q105715627}} occurred; it may have been confused with the Hōei Earthquake, which falls within the same Sexagenary cycle.
* In {{ill|Hōei|en|Hōei|qid=Q1145262|lt=Hōei}} 4 (1707 AD), the "Teigai no Hen" (Crisis of 亥) occurred, marked by the {{ill|1707 Hōei earthquake|en|1707 Hōei earthquake|qid=Q2001581|lt=Hōei Earthquake}}<ref>[https://cir.nii.ac.jp/crid/1390572174727612416 都司嘉宣(1981)] 都司嘉宣編: 高知県地震津波史料, 防災科学技術研究資料 57, i-253, 1981-03-20, 独立行政法人防災科学技術研究所</ref> and the {{ill|Hōei eruption|en|Hōei eruption|qid=Q288045|lt=Hōei Great Eruption}}.
* From January 25 to February 6, 2008, the Teigai Snow Disaster occurred; since this period fell before the Lunisolar New Year (正月) and Spring Festival (春節), it is considered part of a Teigai year.

==Months of Yin Fire Pig==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|October|en|October|qid=Q124|lt=October}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Fire Pig|ja|丁亥|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Teigai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Beginning of Winter}} until the day before {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow}}) as applicable.
